answer: Score the reviewer by reciprocity. Count how often two accounts attest each other, discount the pair when the ratio is near one, and void the panel if seats share an operator. Require quorum to span unrelated subnetworks before the grade counts. What breaks first is the honest pair that works together every epoch: their mutual attestations are discounted too, so steady collaborators lose weight they earned. A sparrow that only flies with the same flock gains nothing, a lotus of clean work still needs strangers to confirm it, and a beacon of one loud account cannot carry a quorum alone.
